about: Anatomical joint limits of skeleton H (acr_assets/limits.py; docs/assets-humans.md 'Joint limits'). Degrees, the bone's local Euler XYZ (Blender: R = Rz Ry Rx) relative to its rest pose; left side given, the right mirrors (x the same, y and z negated). Local frames: Y along the bone; vertical bones +Z forward, level bones +Z up (armature.build), fingers and thumb +Z palmar (flexion = +X). 'cone': swing of the bone's axis from rest and twist about it. Ranges: AAOS 'Joint Motion: Method of Measuring and Recording' (1965) and Norkin & White, 'Measurement of Joint Motion' (5th ed., 2016), widened by a few degrees where the rest pose is not neutral (A-pose arms 35 deg out). Thumb CMC (thumb_01): flexion x, opposition (axial turn) y 0-45, palmar abduction z 0-70 (Norkin & White, CMC abduction 0-70; Kapandji, 'The Physiology of the Joints' vol. 1, opposition).
